name: bead-pane
description: Click a beads issue ID in Claude's replies to open the bead in a side pane: status, children, blockers, notes

bd_path.title: bd command
bd_path.description: The bd executable: a name on the PATH Claude Code starts with, or a full path such as /opt/homebrew/bin/bd

reply_links.title: Bead links in replies
reply_links.description: below: a row of links under each reply that names a bead, with the reply drawn as Claude Code draws it. inline: the IDs in the reply become links, but the desktop draws such a reply at a slightly different text size.
